features.name: Fort McHenry Visitor Center
features.description: The Paul S. Sarbanes Visitor and Education Center is the free orientation hub for Fort McHenry, with the film, museum, ranger desk, bookstore, restrooms and Star Fort pass sales.

features.name: Star Fort
features.description: The historic Star Fort is Fort McHenry's paid interior zone, preserving original brick, bastions, barracks and exhibits spanning the War of 1812 through World War I.

details.coordinateSource: OpenStreetMap named historic fort reviewed against current NPS visitor guidance
details.imageAlt: Star Fort at Fort McHenry National Monument and Historic Shrine

features.name: Fort McHenry Seawall Trail
features.description: The Fort McHenry Seawall Trail is a free paved one-mile loop connecting the Visitor Center area with Patapsco River views, benches, cherry trees, interpretive signs and Orpheus.

details.positionQuality: Seawall Trail start beside the Visitor and Education Center

features.name: Orpheus Statue
features.description: Orpheus with the Awkward Foot is the large 1922 Francis Scott Key monument beside the west side of Fort McHenry's Seawall Trail.
